items.title: TOTAL DEVOTION
items.quote: For the musician, by the servant of Hashem, by David.
items.text: Aspire to identify yourself as an eved (servant) of Hashem, following David’s example. This means no matter where you go, no matter what you do, your thoughts should always be of Hashem, your Master.

items.title: TODAY
items.quote: On a day that Hashem had delivered him.
items.text: Your gratitude to Hashem for all that He has done for you over the course of your life should be fresh and vibrant, as though it happened today.

items.title: LOVE
items.quote: I will [sing of my] love for You, Hashem, for You are my Strength.
items.text: As you express your love for Hashem in song, think how He provides you with the strength to face all challenges that life has to offer.

items.title: FORTRESS
items.quote: Hashem is my Rock, my Fortress.
items.text: As you express your total reliance on Hashem, form images in your mind of His fortress-like strength as it pertains to you personally.

items.w: מהלל אקרא יהוה ומן איבי אושע
items.title: UNCONDITIONAL BOND
items.quote: I call unto Hashem with praise. I am saved from my enemies.
items.text: Think of your feeling of love towards Hashem as being unconditional, based on lifelong gratitude. Thus, you want to praise Him even when you are not in distress. His love for you will then also be unconditional. He will save you from enemies without even having to ask for help.

items.w: על כן אודך בגוים יהוה ולשמך אזמרה
items.title: SANCTIFY THE NAME
items.quote: Therefore, I shall give thanks to You among the nations, Hashem. I will sing praise to Your Name.
items.text: Share your experiences and your knowledge of Hashem with all people within the sound of your voice.
